system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: ksweather_get_historical_weather and ksweather_raise_grievance. For your information, my description is dummy_description_9951, my start_date is dummy_start_date_3403, my end_date is dummy_end_date_2966, my grievance_category is dummy_grievance_category_4328, my aadhaar_number is 100020005440, my location is dummy_location_9425.

function.name: ksweather_raise_grievance
function.description: Raises a grievance about weather data quality. Valid categories: 'incorrect_forecast', 'missing_weather_data', 'delayed_update', 'wrong_location', 'alert_not_received'. Farmer must verify data first. Requires session_token. Does NOT correct data. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

function.name: ksweather_get_historical_weather
function.description: Retrieves historical weather data for a location for the recent past (last 7-30 days only). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide forecasts or real-time data. Fails if location is invalid or historical data is unavailable for the requested period. Data may be partial for some regions.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be within last 30 days.
